Since 1973

About KSI Plus

KSI Plus is run by the Khullar family, who have made operation theatre equipment since ARKO was founded in 1973. The office is in Panchkula and the equipment is built at the company’s works in Derabassi.

  1. 1973

    ARKO is founded

    Late Shri R.K. Khullar establishes ARKO, the foundation of the family's medical manufacturing legacy.

  2. Then

    KSI Medicare

    Deepak Kumar Khullar, after years mastering OT tables and surgical lights at ARKO, builds KSI Medicare into a trusted supplier for hospitals from Punjab to Assam.

  3. Today

    KSI Plus

    A new generation of equipment: 128 products across 9 categories, CE and ISO 13485 certified, manufactured at our own works in Derabassi.

  4. Next

    Surgical robotics

    Robotic arms for surgery, currently in development.

Leadership

DK

Deepak Kumar Khullar

Carrying the legacy forward

Over 30 years mastering operation tables, surgical lights and hospital infrastructure. He carries forward the legacy his father began at ARKO.

RM

Rohit Marwha

Marketing, sales & business development

Began his career at Ranbaxy, rising to Zonal Head. Leads KSI's market strategy, outreach and customer engagement.

MK

Mehul Khullar

Engineering & operations

Third generation of the Khullar family. B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, educated at The Lawrence School, Sanawar. Drives technical innovation and operational precision.

Certifications

Our quality management system is certified for medical devices, and our products carry CE certificates of compliance. Copies of certificates are available on request.
